title: Pattern matcher inserts replacement poorly
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

In vllm, we currently have a [workaround](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/compilation/multi_output_match.py) for pattern-match + replacement of multi-output pattern as a relic of an old bug (#137280). I tried to remove it, and I got the following error:
```
RuntimeError: Argument 'permute' of Node 'auto_functionalized_2' was used before it has been defined! Please check that Nodes in the graph are topologically ordered
```

Would be good to get a temporary workaround as well.

error_description: In vllm, there is a workaround for pattern-match + replacement of multi-output pattern as a relic of an old bug (#137280). When attempting to remove this workaround, a RuntimeError occurs: 'Argument 'permute' of Node 'auto_functionalized_2' was used before it has been defined! Please check that Nodes in the graph are topologically ordered'. The user is requesting a temporary workaround.
